senses.gloss:
तुजि, इस्, f., Ved. propagation, begetting children;
(इस्), m., Ved., N. of a man protected by Indra.
तुजि तुजि. See under 1. तुच्, col. 2.

तुज् 2. तुज् or तुञ्ज्, cl. 1. 6. P., Ved. तो-
जति, तुजति, तुतोज, तोजितुम्, or cl. 1. P.
तुञ्जति, तुतुञ्ज, तुञ्जितुम्, Ved. Inf. तुजसे, to
strike, hit; impel, push; to press out, emit; to stir
up, urge on, instigate, incite; wave to and fro; to
hasten; Ved. reach, extend, project; to kill or hurt;
to guard, protect, to be strong; to clothe; to live:
Pass. तुज्यते, &c., to be struck, to be vexed, &c.: Caus.
तुजयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to promote, instigate; to
move quickly, spring, run [cf. तूतुजान]; तुञ्जयति
or तोजयति, -यितुम्, to hurt, to injure or kill; to be
strong or vigorous; to give or take; to dwell, abide;
to shine, speak; [cf. तूतुजि.]

3. तुज्, क् (?), f., Ved. shock, impulse; pressure;
assault; (क्, क्, क्), pressing, urging on, impelling.

तुज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be struck or pushed, to
be impelled.
